slides.say: So where should keys come from? From your data, created once, never during render.

slides.text: Database data? Use its IDs. They are unique by nature.
slides.say: Data from a database already has IDs. They are unique by nature, so use them.
Data made in your app, like notes? Give each item an ID when you create it, with a counter or crypto random UUID, and save it with the item.

slides.text: Keys must not change. Never generate them while rendering.
slides.say: Never generate keys while rendering. A random key never matches the last render, so React recreates every item. It is slow and loses user input.
